title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema verify --format json
description: Row counts compared between each source table, read through the foreign schema (--source-schema), and its target table (SchemaToSchemaMigrator.verify_migration). A mismatch still writes this shape, with matched false, and exits 1. The CLI assembles the envelope around it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

tables.description: Each verified target table (--tables, else every table --mapping maps), by name.

source_count.description: Rows in the source table, by its source name when the mapping renames it.

match.description: True when the two counts are equal.

difference.description: target_count − source_count; negative means rows missing from the target.

matched.description: True when every table matched; false exits 1.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
